notes: Exit is unpinned by the spec's own text: 'Execute stop exits as stop orders updated each bar (or equivalent logic in next())' licenses two mechanisms with different primary-key tapes (intrabar stop fill at the trigger bar vs next-bar-open market close). The SMA-cross exit is stated only for longs ('close the long when close crosses below SMA(20)'); whether shorts exit on a cross above SMA(20) is unstated. 'trailing stop distance = 3 * ATR(14)' with stops 'updated each bar' also leaves current-bar vs entry-frozen ATR arguable. Entry ('enter long at the next bar open when the prior bar close crosses above SMA(20)'), params (SMA 20, ATR 14, 3x), and sizing ('Use default sizer') are pinned; binding is coherent (prose AAPL 5m == bound AAPL_5m.pkl, 4680 rows 2026-04-15..2026-07-10) and no hardcoded price levels exist.
